tickets.title: Prepare first-year college funding comparison
tickets.text: Prepare a comparison for Liora Dewspindle of using Nia Dewspindle's 529 balance at Velvet Acorn Custody (about $74,600), taxable brokerage assets (about $412,000 including $118,000 of Cloudberry Kite Robotics shares), expected bonus cash, and a limited sale of Cloudberry Kite Robotics shares to cover the first-year college funding gap while preserving the $80,000 cash reserve floor at Teacup Comet Bank.
tickets.evidence: They agreed that by 2026-03-20 a comparison will be prepared of using Nia’s 529 balance, taxable brokerage assets, expected bonus cash, and a limited sale of Cloudberry Kite Robotics shares to cover the first-year college funding gap while preserving Liora’s stated cash reserve floor.

tickets.title: Select tuition payment method for Marzipan Meadow University
tickets.text: Help Liora Dewspindle select a tuition payment method for Marzipan Meadow University, choosing between the semester lump-sum payment and the monthly payment plan offered in the portal, so the first bill can be processed.
tickets.evidence: A tuition payment method selection is needed by 2026-04-15 because the Marzipan Meadow University portal offers a semester lump-sum payment or monthly payment plan, and the family has not chosen the method needed before the first bill can be processed.

tickets.title: Collect current education account statements
tickets.text: Obtain current statements for Nia Dewspindle's 529 account and Owen Dewspindle's 529 account at Velvet Acorn Custody, plus the grandparent-owned education account Dorian Dewspindle mentioned, to confirm account ownership, balances, and available distribution options.
tickets.evidence: Current statements for Nia’s 529 account, Owen’s 529 account, and a grandparent-owned education account Dorian mentioned are needed by 2026-03-18 because the planning file lacks them and account ownership, balances, and available distribution options cannot be confirmed.

tickets.title: Reconcile Nia's 529 balance discrepancy

tickets.evidence: They agreed to reconcile the 529 balance by 2026-03-18 because Liora’s tuition spreadsheet lists Nia’s 529 balance at about $82,000, while the portal statement shows about $74,600 after a prior distribution, and the source of the difference was not identified during the call.
